:::::: {.hub-body}
For students who already know data analysis or econometrics. Five weeks on setup, from raw data to report, wrangling and debugging, econometrics and text as data. Then a three-session capstone on manager changes in football, with web scraping, LLM APIs and difference-in-differences.

## Which course is for me?

**Data Analysis with AI** assumes a course in econometrics or data analysis and some coding in Python or R. It goes all the way to scraping, LLM APIs and modern causal econometrics.

**The friendly introduction** assumes neither. You give instructions in plain language, you use one tool, and you work on material from your own field. If you have never used an AI agent, it is a good place to start either way.
